item.title: MSF suspends some work at Gaza's Nasser Hospital due to presence of armed men
item.description: TEL AVIV, Israel (AP) — Doctors Without Borders has announced the suspension of some operations at one of Gaza 's largest functioning hospitals after patients and staff reported seeing armed, masked men roaming parts of the building. Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis is one of the territory's few functioning hospitals. Hundreds of patients and war-wounded [...]

item.title: City of Syracuse fires snow removal company responsible for sidewalks
item.description: The City of Syracuse has ended its contract with Kimble and Kimble due to ongoing performance issues and has rehired JSK to complete sidewalk clearing for the rest of the season.

item.description: Funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) ran out at midnight, marking the third — but smallest — government shutdown of President Trump's second term as Democrats demand reforms to immigration enforcement practices. item.title: Syracuse wins last-second thriller over SMU
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) - Syracuse rallied from down double-digits in the second half to stun SMU 79-78 at the JMA Wireless Dome on Saturday. Nate Kingz scored on a driving layup with under five seconds to play to complete the comeback win for the Orange. Donnie Freeman paced the Orange attack with 18 points. SU [...]

item.title: Love ran throughout Onondaga Lake Park this Valentine's Day -- and for a charitable cause
item.description: LIVERPOOL, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) -- For its 18th year, a local non-profit raising money for disability awareness held its annual Cupid's Chase 5K at Onondaga Lake Park on Valentine's Day. NewsChannel 9 | LocalSYR.com meteorologist Kate Thornton emceed the event. Photos by Joe Guido. Captions by Quinn Youngs.
